1.1: Meematay korin et shema bearvit. mishshaa shehakkohanim nichnasim leechol bitrumatan, ad sof haashmura harishona, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, ad chatzot. rabban gamliel omer, ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. maase shebbau vanav mibbet hammishte, amru lo, lo karinu et shema. amar lahem, im lo ala ammud hashshachar, chayyavin attem likrot. velo zo bilvad, ella kol ma sheamru chachamim ad chatzot, mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. hekter chalavim veevarim, mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. vechol hanneechalim leyom echad, mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. im ken, lamma amru chachamim ad chatzot, kede leharechik et haadam min haavera:
1.2: Meematay korin et shema beshacharit. mishsheyyakkir ben techelet lelavan. rabbi eliezer omer, ben techelet lecharti. vegomrah ad hanetz hachamma. rabbi yehoshua omer, ad shalosh shaot, shekken derech bene melachim laamod beshalosh shaot. hakkore mikkan veelach lo hifsid, keadam hakkore vattora:
1.3: Bet shammay omrim, baerev kol adam yattu veyikreu, uvabboker yaamdu, shenneemar (Devarim 6) uveshachbecha uvekumecha. uvet hillel omrim, kol adam kore chedarko, shenneemar (sham) uvelechtecha vadderech. im ken, lamma neemar uveshachbecha uvekumecha, beshaa shebbene adam shochvim, uveshaa shebbene adam omdim. amar rabbi tarfon, ani hayiti va vadderech, vehitteti likrot, kedivre vet shammay, vesikkanti veatzmi mippene hallistim. amru lo, keday hayita lachuv beatzmecha, sheavarta al divre vet hillel:
1.4: Bashshachar mevarech shetayim lefaneha veachat leachareha, uvaerev shetayim lefaneha ushetayim leachareha. achat arukka veachat ketzara. makom sheamru lehaarich, eno rashshay lekatztzer. lekatztzer, eno rashshay lehaarich. lachtom, eno rashshay shello lachtom. veshello lachtom, eno rashshay lachtom:
1.5: Mazkirin yetziat mitzrayim ballelot. amar rabbi elazar ben azarya, hare ani keven shivim shana, velo zachiti shetteamer yetziat mitzrayim ballelot, ad shedderashah ben zoma, shenneemar (Devarim 16) lemaan tizkor et yom tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim kol yeme chayyecha. yeme chayyecha, hayyamim. kol yeme chayyecha, hallelot. vachachamim omrim, yeme chayyecha, haolam hazze. kol yeme chayyecha, lehavi limot hammashiach:

2.1: Haya kore vattora, vehiggia zeman hammikra, im kivven libbo, yatza. veim lav, lo yatza. bapperakim shoel mippene hakkavod umeshiv, uvaemtza shoel mippene hayyira umeshiv, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, baemtza shoel mippene hayyira, umeshiv mippene hakkavod, bapperakim shoel mippene hakkavod, umeshiv shalom lechol adam:
2.2: Ellu hen ben happerakim, ben beracha rishona lishniyya, ben sheniyya lishma, uven shema livhaya im shamoa, ben vehaya im shamoa levayyomer, ben vayyomer leemet veyatztziv. rabbi yehuda omer, ben vayyomer leemet veyatztziv lo yafsik. amar rabbi yehoshua ben karcha, lamma kadma shema livhaya im shamoa, ella chede sheyyekabbel alav ol malchut shamayim techilla, veachar kach yekabbel alav ol mitzvot. vehaya im shamoa levayyomer, shevhaya im shamoa noheg bayyom uvallayla, vayyomer eno noheg ella bayyom:
2.3: Hakkore et shema velo hishmia leazno, yatza. rabbi yose omer, lo yatza. kara velo dikdek beotiyyoteha, rabbi yose omer yatza, rabbi yehuda omer lo yatza. hakkore lemafrea, lo yatza. kara vetaa, yachazor lemakom shettaa:
2.4: Haummanin korin berosh hailan o verosh hannidbach, ma sheenan rashshain laasot ken battefilla:
2.5: Chatan patur mikkeriat shema ballayla harishon ad motzae shabbat, im lo asa maase. maase berabban gamliel shekkara vallayla harishon shennasa. amru lo talmidav, lo limmadtanu, rabbenu, shechatan patur mikkeriat shema ballayla harishon. amar lahem, eni shomea lachem levattel mimmenni malchut shamayim afillu shaa echat:
2.6: Rachatz layla harishon shemmeta ishto. amru lo talmidav, lo limmadtanu, rabbenu, sheavel asur lirchotz. amar lahem, eni chishar kol adam, istenis ani:
2.7: Ucheshemmet tavi avdo, kibbel alav tanchumin. amru lo talmidav, lo limmadtanu rabbenu, sheen mekabbelin tanchumin al haavadim. amar lahem, en tavi avdi kishar kol haavadim, kasher haya:
2.8: Chatan im ratza likrot keriat shema layla harishon, kore. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo chol harotze littol et hashshem yittol:

3.1: Mi shemmeto mutal lefanav, patur mikkeriat shema, min hattefilla umin hattefillin. nose hammitta vechillufehen vechillufe chillufehen, et shellifne hammitta veet shelleachar hammitta, et shellammitta tzorech bahen peturim, veet sheen lammitta tzorech bahen chayyavin. ellu vaellu peturim min hattefilla:
3.2: Kavru et hammet vechazru, im yecholin lehatechil veligmor ad shello yaggiu lashshura, yatchilu. veim lav, lo yatchilu. haomdim bashshura, happenimim peturim, vehachitzonim chayyavin:
3.3: Nashim vaavadim uketannim peturin mikkeriat shema umin hattefillin, vechayyavin bitfilla uvimzuza, uvevirkat hammazon:
3.4: Baal keri mehareher belibbo veeno mevarech, lo lefaneha velo leachareha. veal hammazon mevarech leacharav, veeno mevarech lefanav. rabbi yehuda omer, mevarech lifnehem uleacharehem:
3.5: Haya omed battefilla, venizkar shehu vaal keri, lo yafsik, ella yekatztzer. yarad litbol, im yachol laalot ulehitkassot velikrot ad shello tanetz hachamma, yaale veyitkasse veyikra. veim lav, yitkasse vammayim veyikra. aval lo yitkasse, lo vammayim haraim velo veme hammishra, ad sheyyattil letochan mayim. vechamma yarchik mehem umin hatztzoa, arba ammot:
3.6: Zav sheraa keri, venidda sheppalta shichvat zera, vehameshammeshet sheraata nidda, tzerichin tevila, verabbi yehuda poter:

4.1: Tefillat hashshachar, ad chatzot. rabbi yehuda omer, ad arba shaot. tefillat hammincha ad haerev. rabbi yehuda omer, ad pelag hammincha. tefillat haerev en lah keva. veshel musafin kol hayyom. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheva shaot:
4.2: Rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana haya mitpallel bichnisato levet hammidrash uvitziato tefilla ketzara. amru lo, ma makom litfilla zo. amar lahem, bichnisati ani mitpallel shello teera takala al yadi, uvitziati ani noten hodaya al chelki:
4.3: Rabban gamliel omer, bechol yom mitpallel adam shemone esre. rabbi yehoshua omer, meen shemone esre. rabbi akiva omer, im shegura tefillato befiv, yitpallel shemone esre. veim lav, meen shemone esre:
4.4: Rabbi eliezer omer, haose tefillato keva, en tefillato tachanunim. rabbi yehoshua omer, hamehallech bimkom sakkana, mitpallel tefilla ketzara. omer, hosha hashshem et ammecha et sheerit yisrael, bechol parashat haibbur yihyu tzarchehem lefanecha. baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla:
4.5: Haya rochev al hachamor, yered. veim eno yachol lered, yachazir et panav, veim eno yachol lehachazir et panav, yechavven et libbo keneged bet kodesh hakkadashim:
4.6: Haya yoshev bisfina o vekaron o veasda, yechavven et libbo keneged bet kodesh hakkadashim:
4.7: Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, en tefillat hammusafin ella bechever ir. vachachamim omrim, bechever ir veshello vechever ir. rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo, kol makom sheyyesh chever ir, hayyachid patur mittefillat hammusafin:

5.1: En omdin lehitpallel ella mittoch koved rosh. chasidim harishonim hayu shohim shaa achat umitpallelim, kede sheyyechavvenu et libbam lammakom. afillu hammelech shoel bishlomo, lo yeshivennu. vaafillu nachash karuch al akevo, lo yafsik:
5.2: Mazkirin gevurot geshamim bitchiyyat hammetim, veshoalin haggeshamim bevirkat hashshanim, vehavedala bechonen haddaat. rabbi akiva omer, omrah beracha reviit bifne atzmah. rabbi eliezer omer, behodaa:
5.3: Haomer al kan tzippor yaggiu rachamecha, veal tov yizzacher shemecha, modim modim, meshattekin oto. haover lifne hatteva vetaa, yaavor acher tachtav, velo yehe sarvan beotah shaa. minnayin hu matchil, mittechillat habberacha shettaa vah:
5.4: Haover lifne hatteva, lo yaane achar hakkohanim amen, mippene hatteruf. veim en sham kohen ella hu, lo yissa et kappav. veim havetachato shehu nose et kappav vechozer litfillato, rashshay:
5.5: Hammitpallel vetaa, siman ra lo. veim sheliach tzibbur hu, siman ra lesholchav, mippene sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto. amru alav al rabbi chanina ven dosa, keshehaya mitpallel al hacholim veomer, ze chay veze met. amru lo, minnayin atta yodea. amar lahem, im shegura tefillati befi, yodea ani shehu mekubbal. veim lav, yodea ani shehu metoraf:

6.1: Ketzad mevarchin al happerot. al perot hailan omer, bore peri haetz, chutz min hayyayin, sheal hayyayin omer bore peri haggafen. veal perot haaretz omer bore peri haadama, chutz min happat, sheal happat hu omer hammotzi lechem min haaretz. veal hayerakot omer bore peri haadama. rabbi yehuda omer, bore mine deshaim:
6.2: Berach al perot hailan bore peri haadama, yatza. veal perot haaretz bore peri haetz, lo yatza. al kullam im amar shehakkol nihya, yatza:
6.3: Al davar sheen giddulo min haaretz omer shehakkol. al hachometz veal hannovlot veal haggovay omer shehakkol. al hechalav veal haggevina veal habbetzim omer shehakkol. rabbi yehuda omer, kol shehu min kelala en mevarchin alav:
6.4: Hayu lefanav minim harebe, rabbi yehuda omer, im yesh benehem mimmin shiva, mevarech alav. vachachamim omrim, mevarech al eze mehem sheyyirtze:
6.5: Berach al hayyayin shellifne hammazon, patar et hayyayin shelleachar hammazon. berach al happarperet shellifne hammazon, patar et happarperet shelleachar hammazon. berach al happat, patar et happarperet. al happarperet, lo fatar et happat. bet shammay omrim, af lo maase kedera:
6.6: Hayu yoshvin leechol, kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. hesebbu, echad mevarech lechullan. ba lahem yayin betoch hammazon, kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. leachar hammazon, echad mevarech lechullam. vehu omer al hammugmar, af al pi sheen meviin et hammugmar ella leachar hasseudda:
6.7: Heviu lefanav maliach battechilla ufat immo, mevarech al hammaliach ufoter et happat, shehappat tefela lo. ze hakkelal, kol shehu ikkar veimmo tefela, mevarech al haikkar ufoter et hattefela:
6.8: Achal teenim anavim verimmonim, mevarech acharehen shalosh berachot, divre rabban gamliel. vachachamim omrim, beracha achat meen shalosh. rabbi akiva omer, afillu achal shelek vehu mezono, mevarech acharav shalosh berachot. hashshote mayim litzmao, omer shehakkol nihye bidvaro. rabbi tarfon omer, bore nefashot rabbot:

7.1: Shelosha sheachlu cheechad, chayyavin lezammen. achal demay, umaaser rishon shennittela terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu, vehashshammash sheachal kazzayit, vehakkuti, mezammenin alehem. aval achal tevel, umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu, vehashshammash sheachal pachot mikkazzayit, vehannachri, en mezammenin alehem:
7.2: Nashim vaavadim uketannim, en mezammenin alehem. ad kamma mezammenin, ad kazzayit. rabbi yehuda omer, ad kabbetza:
7.3: Ketzad mezammenin, bishlosha omer nevarech. bishlosha vehu, omer barchu. baasara, omer nevarech lelohenu. baasara vahu, omer barchu. echad asara veechad asara ribbo. bemea omer, nevarech layya elohenu. bemea vehu, omer barchu. beelef, omer nevarech layya elohenu elohe yisrael. beelef vehu, omer barchu. beribbo, omer, nevarech layya elohenu elohe yisrael elohe hatztzevaot yoshev hakkeruvim al hammazon sheachalnu. beribbo vehu, omer barchu. keinyan shehu mevarech, kach onin acharav, baruch Adonai elohenu elohe yisrael elohe hatztzevaot yoshev hakkeruvim al hammazon sheachalnu. rabbi yose haggelili omer, lefi rov hakkahal hen mevarchin, shenneemar bemakhelot barchu elohim, Adonai mimmekor yisrael (tehillim sach). amar rabbi akiva, ma matzinu bevet hakkeneset, echad merubbin veechad muatin omer, barchu et Adonai. rabbi yishmael omer, barchu et Adonai hamevorach:
7.4: Shelosha sheachlu cheechad, enan rashshain lechalek, vechen arbaa, vechen chamishsha. shishsha nechelakin, ad asara. vaasara enan nechelakin, ad sheyyihyu esrim:
7.5: Shete chavurot shehayu ochlot bevayit echad, bizman shemmiktzatan roin ellu et ellu, hare ellu mitztarfim lezimmun. veim lav, ellu mezammenin leatzman, veellu mezammenin leatzman. en mevarchin al hayyayin ad sheyyitten letocho mayim, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, mevarchin:

8.1: Ellu devarim shebben bet shammay uvet hillel basseudda. bet shammay omrim, mevarech al hayyom veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin. uvet hillel omrim, mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hayyom:
8.2: Bet shammay omrim, notlin layyadayim, veachar kach mozgin et hakkos. uvet hillel omrim, mozgin et hakkos veachar kach notlin layyadayim:
8.3: Bet shammay omrim, mekanneach yadav bammappa umannichah al hashshulchan. uvet hillel omrim, al hakkeset:
8.4: Bet shammay omrim, mechabbedin et habbayit veachar kach notlin layyadayim. uvet hillel omrim, notlin layyadayim veachar kach mechabbedin et habbayit:
8.5: Bet shammay omrim, ner umazon uvesamim vehavedala. uvet hillel omrim, ner uvesamim umazon vehavedala. bet shammay omrim, shebbara meor haesh. uvet hillel omrim, bore meore haesh:
8.6: En mevarchin lo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel ovde chochavim, velo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel metim, velo al hanner velo al habbesamim shellifne avoda zara. en mevarchin al hanner ad sheyyeotu leoro:
8.7: Mi sheachal veshachach velo verach, bet shammay omrim, yachazor limkomo vivarech. uvet hillel omrim, yevarech bammakom shennizkar. ad ematay hu mevarech. ad kede sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav:
8.8: Ba lahem yayin leachar hammazon veen sham ella oto hakkos, bet shammay omrim, mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hammazon. uvet hillel omrim, mevarech al hammazon veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin. onin amen achar yisrael hamevarech, veen onin amen achar hakkuti hamevarech, ad sheyyishma kol habberacha:

9.1: Haroe makom shennaasu vo nissim leyisrael, omer baruch sheasa nissim laavotenu bammakom hazze. makom shenneekra mimmennu avoda zara, omer baruch sheakar avoda zara meartzenu:
9.2: Al hazzikin, veal hazzevaot, veal habberakim, veal haramim, veal haruchot, omer baruch shekkocho ugevurato male olam. al heharim, veal haggevaot, veal hayyammim, veal hanneharot, veal hammidbarot, omer baruch ose maase vereshit. rabbi yehuda omer, haroe et hayyam haggadol omer baruch sheasa et hayyam haggadol, bizman sheroe oto lifrakim. al haggeshamim veal habbesorot hattovot omer baruch hattov vehammetiv, veal shemuot raot omer baruch dayyan haemet:
9.3: Bana vayit chadash, vekana chelim chadashim, omer baruch shehecheyanu. mevarech al haraa meen hattova, veal hattova meen haraa. hatztzoek lesheavar, hare zo tefillat shav. ketzad. hayta ishto meubberet, veamar, yehi ratzon shetteled ishti zachar, hare zo tefillat shav. haya va vadderech veshama kol tzevacha bair, veamar yehi ratzon shello yihyu ellu bene veti, hare zo tefillat shav:
9.4: Hannichnas lichrach mitpallel shetayim, achat bichnisato veachat bitziato. ben azzay omer, arba, shetayim bichnisato ushetayim bitziato, venoten hodaa lesheavar, vetzoek leatid lavo:
9.5: Chayyav adam levarech al haraa keshem shehu mevarech al hattova, shenneemar (Devarim 6) veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha uvechol meodecha. bechol levavcha, bishne yetzarecha, beyetzer tov uveyetzer ra. uvechol nafshecha, afillu hu notel et nafshecha. uvechol meodecha, bechol mamonecha. davar acher bechol meodecha, bechol midda umidda shehu moded lecha heve mode lo bimod meod. lo yakel adam et rosho keneged shaar hammizrach, shehu mechuvvan keneged bet kadshe hakkadashim. lo yikkanes lehar habbayit bemaklo, uveminalo, uvefundato, uveavak sheal raglav, velo yaasennu kappandarya, urekika mikkal vachomer. kol chotme verachot shehayu vammikdash, hayu omrim min haolam. mishshekkilkelu hamminin, veamru, en olam ella echad, hitkinu sheyyehu omrim, min haolam vead haolam. vehitkinu, sheyyehe adam shoel et shelom chavero bashshem, shenneemar (Rut b) vehinne voaz ba mibbet lechem, vayyomer lakkotzrim Adonai immachem, vayyomru lo, yevarechcha Adonai. veomer (Shoftim 6) Adonai immecha gibbor hechayil. veomer (Mishlei 23) al tavuz ki zakna immecha. veomer (tehillim kayit) et laasot layya heferu toratecha. rabbi natan omer, heferu toratecha et laasot layya:
